column1: # Button text and the labels and tooltips of this mod's settings window (ModHelper.GetLocalized). Format: key

column2: Show "Collect {0}" in the right-click menu of water containers. It pours the water from every Moisture Farm in your shop that makes {0} (as shown in its tooltip) into the container, fullest first, until the container is full. Moisture Farms placed in the Vending Fountain are left alone.
